name: browser_use
description: Web-only background AI browser research. Requires the saved background-task allowlist and callback service; never runs in the foreground, voice, Talk, Firefox Companion, CLI, or workflows. Use for multi-page research or JavaScript-rendered sites when the user asks you to browse. Reads pages and follows links; cannot log in, submit forms, purchase, upload, or change accounts. Supply the complete goal and a starting URL. Uses this conversation's selected LLM provider and model. Returns a receipt immediately and a sourced report later through a callback.

availability.setup_hint: Pull the Browser Use image with docker compose -f docker-compose.browser.yml pull. See docs/BROWSER-USE.md.

task.description: Research goal and information to report. Include all relevant context.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) page to begin browsing. Prefer a direct publisher or topic page over Google Search or Google News, which commonly returns an automation challenge.

test_input.task: Read the page and report its title and purpose.
